skills.name: tax-calculator
skills.description: Calculate US federal, state, and local taxes for 2026. Supports all 50 states with paycheck, sales tax, property tax, and self-employment calculators.

skills.name: sales-tax-lookup
skills.description: Look up sales tax rates by state and zip code for all 50 US states. Includes reverse tax calculator.

skills.name: state-tax-comparison
skills.description: Compare tax burdens between US states side-by-side. Includes income tax, property tax, and sales tax comparisons.

skills.name: lottery-tax-calculator
skills.description: Calculate how much tax you pay on lottery winnings. Federal + state taxes, lump sum vs annuity comparison.
